reason: I already have three brand emails sitting in my inbox and a rate card I pitch from every week, so I don't need a marketplace to find deals, and I'm not handing over $50 of every $500 for a platform that admits it barely has brands yet. The escrow is nice, but my deals mostly pay already.
objection: Another marketplace taking a cut of my money, with too few brands to bring me anything I wouldn't land myself.
would_change_my_mind: No cut on deals I bring in myself (only charge on brands Collabo actually finds me), or proof it has enough paying brands to send me real bookings I wouldn't get otherwise.
